objective: Same causal rules beat CSI300 price index in both 2024 and 2025 after modeled costs
classification: Opened-history search, including research selection bias; never a new independent final test
time_fix: Opening-order availability uses prior-session volume, not current full-session volume. Capacity and volatility remain lagged exactly once.
first_batch: Equal8 ranks blended with 120d momentum or 252d momentum excluding20d, Equal8 weights 0.25/0.5/0.75; all six under Buffer30/60 and Buffer20/40
next_batch_if_needed: Weekly signal and holding-period research using the same causality gates; register details before evaluation
costs: Original 1m CNY, fees/taxes, 5bp slippage, impact, 1% lagged ADV; successful historical candidates additionally evaluated at15bp and10m
search_reporting: Keep all candidates, no manual calendar-year switches, no ex-post stock deletion, no outcome-based feature threshold inside signal
